title: scan fail_build set to true exits with error
body:
### New Issue Checklist - [X] Updated fastlane to the latest version - [X] I have read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Issue Description According to `fastlane action scan`, **fail_build** default value is set to true and yet, when running on a lane `scan(fail_build: true)`, it exists with an Error. I'm no expert in **Ruby** but should this error be expected? ##### Error output ``` ERROR [2016-11-15 18:47:34.59]: fastlane finished with errors /usr/local/lib/ruby/gems/2.3.0/gems/fastlane_core-0.55.0/lib/fastlane_core/ui/interface.rb:145:in 'user_error!': [!] 'fail_build' value must be a String! Found TrueClass instead. (FastlaneCore::Interface::FastlaneError) ``` ### Environment
